# Terms

Definitions used across Fernwood Metrics documents.

## Active seat
A user who signed in during the current billing cycle. Seat limits are in [usage limits](../products/usage-limits.md).

## Billing cycle
The period between two invoices: one month or one year. See [invoicing](../processes/invoicing.md).

## Workspace
The container for one customer's data and users. A customer has one or more workspaces.

## Account closure
The moment a customer ends the subscription. It starts the retention clock in [data retention](../policies/data-retention.md).

## Credit note
A document that reduces what a customer owes or is paid back, linked to an earlier invoice.

## First purchase
The first successful payment for a workspace, not a trial start.

## Severity
How serious an incident or ticket is; see [severity levels](severity-levels.md).

## IdP
Identity provider: the customer's system that signs users in for [single sign-on](../products/sso-setup.md).
